Student Property · Great Location · Available Summer 2024

My Property Box are delighted to welcome to the market this classic first floor Tyneside flat. Located within a close walking distance to West Jesmond metro station with good local bus services and road links in and out of the city centre. There is an array of local shops on Brentwood Avenue with further shopping and supermarkets on Acorn Road and Waitrose on Osborne Road. The property accommodation comprises: A light and contemporary feel throughout with plan living room and well appointed kitchen, double glazing throughout, gas central heating, three double bedrooms and shower room. To arrange a viewing please call My Property Box today 0191 212 0400.
